title: Node stays RUNNING after terminal receive task failure
description: python/src/lichen/node.py _receive_loop correctly re-raises LinkPersistenceError/LinkSecurityClockError, but Node only probes _receive_task during start() (lines 626-634). A terminal failure occurring after start returns leaves the task completed while state remains RUNNING and the announce/adapter tasks continue; no lifecycle transition or observable failure occurs until a later stop gathers it. Add task supervision/done handling that transitions or shuts down deterministically and preserves the terminal error, with a test injecting failure after RUNNING.
